feeds.title: The Flight Deal
feeds.description: Just because it's a great fare doesn't mean it's a great deal. We provide tips and tricks on maximizing frequent flyer accumulation for miles traveled, web promotions, customer reward points and wise redemption of these awards. That's what we decided makes a deal truly great. The Flight Deal team loves to travel. We combine true wanderlust with our passion for practicality.

feeds.title: Nomadic Matt Blog
feeds.description: Become an expert travel hacker and earn free flights and hotel stays with these practical, money-saving tips! I'm Nomadic Matt, a New York Times best-selling author of How to Travel the World on $50 a Day and Ten Years a Nomad, as well as the founder of this website!

feeds.title: Money We Have » Travel Hacking
feeds.description: Established in 2014, Money We Have has quickly become one of the most trusted sources in Canada when it comes to personal finance and travel. By providing practical information on all things related to money and travel, Money We Have encourages Canadians and travellers from all over the world to make smarter financial decisions. Know more about our travel hacking, loyalty programs and more in this section.

feeds.title: Katie's Travel Tricks Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Katie! I'm a mom of 2 based in Chicago. Our family loves deals. My goal is to provide families with points information tailored just to them. I'm hoping this site serves as a guide for you to get started with miles and points in a way that doesn't feel overwhelming.

feeds.title: A Purple Life » Travel Hacking
feeds.description: A Purple Life is a lifestyle blog cataloging my journey to and through retirement. Browse through my travel hacking section to know more about optimal deals, my travels using various deals and more!

feeds.title: Suitesmile
feeds.description: Suitesmile is a travel hacking blog from Singapore. Learn tips and tricks on travel and the best ways to earn and redeem credit card miles and points!

feeds.title: Travel Hacking Mom Blog
feeds.description: We are a trio of mothers teaching you to travel the world using points for free or nearly free. We do it and we want to share our knowledge with others in an easy-to-understand way.

feeds.title: The Travel Hack
feeds.description: The Travel Hack is a blog about stylish adventure travel and affordable luxury. We believe luxurious travel can be affordable and isn't just for the rich. Follow along with our worldwide adventures as we share our trips and tips for incredible travel experiences on a modest budget.

feeds.title: Travel Mom Squad
feeds.description: Hi! We are Pam and Alex, a mother-daughter duo who love to travel! We have spent the last few years mastering how to travel for nearly free using credit card points. Now we want to share what we've learned so you can be off on your own adventures.

feeds.title: Frequent Miler

feeds.title: GRRRL Traveler » Travel Tips

feeds.title: Travelzoo Blog

feeds.title: Thrifty Traveler

feeds.title: Knack Blog
feeds.description: Our views on getting out your front door more often, so you can discover new places, meet new people, and enjoy all that's around you with Knack backpacks.

feeds.description: The Luxury Vacation Guide blog features reviews of luxury properties and travel destinations. It is authored by a blogger/photojournalist team and provides articles and guides on specific locations, including islands, beaches, ski resorts, and cruise destinations.

feeds.title: Lounge Nerd
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest news and reviews about airport lounges, clubs, sensory rooms, hotels, and other amenities.

feeds.description: Explore our articles on traveling on budget using miles and points of loyalty programs, credit card points and more! The Frugal Tourist is working towards Financial Independence while Frugally Traveling the World using Miles and Points.

feeds.title: Going Awesome Places » Travel hacking
feeds.description: Hey, my name is Will and I'm here to help you travel to some awesome places around the world and my home country of Canada by providing insanely detailed itineraries, travel guides, and packing lists. feeds.title: JetsetChristina » Travel Tips

feeds.title: Prince of Travel » Miles & Points

My name is Ricky, and I started this website to help you raise your travel game. The globe is my passion, and I'm on a never-ending quest to gain a complete understanding of every square inch of our beautiful planet.

feeds.title: Best Wallet Hacks » Travel Joyfully
feeds.description: We love to travel and even after having kids, we make it a point to travel as often as our sanity allows. This part of the site details some of the tools we use, the strategies we employ, and other ways we try to make the most of our money when we travel. Hi - I'm Jim. I've been writing about personal finance for over 15+ years and been featured in the New York Times, Baltimore Sun, Marketplace Money, Entrepreneur, BusinessWeek, U.S. News and World Report, and more.
